name: Reliable AI Scientific Software
goal: Investigate scholarly methods and empirical evidence for making AI-assisted scientific software development reliable: agentic coding and review, reproducible configuration, provenance and source-of-truth management, unit and dimensional checking, symbolic and numerical verification, CI or pre-commit enforcement, adversarial or independent verification, and human-in-the-loop oversight. Identify what is transferable to Claude Code, chat, Cowork and MCP-based workflows and what remains unvalidated or product-specific.
summary:
Reliable AI-assisted scientific software is best supported by a LAYERED ARCHITECTURE that limits the model to planning, translation or parameterisation while deterministic templates, schemas, environments, tests and INDEPENDENT SCIENTIFIC ORACLES control execution [Upa26, Ho26, Str26, Ada26b].

EXECUTION IS NOT CORRECTNESS: MDGYM reports at most 21 percent success on easy molecular-dynamics tasks and under 10 percent on harder ones [Kum26], while 39 TO 40 PERCENT OF RUNNABLE MULTIPHYSICS CASES STILL SOLVE THE WRONG PDE [Son26b].

MOST TRANSFERABLE CONTROLS:
- REPRODUCIBLE STATE: declarative environments, containers, dependency manifests and provenance graphs. Only 68.3 percent of agent-generated projects ran cleanly, with 13.5x more runtime than declared dependencies [Van25], whereas Guix/Apptainer plus AiiDA achieved BIT-IDENTICAL cross-cluster results [Bil25].
- EXECUTABLE SCIENTIFIC CONTRACTS: schema-gated plans, fixed solver templates, unit and dimensional checks, metamorphic or regression tests, manufactured solutions, convergence and error checks [Xia20, Ore17b, Lin18d, Ric15, Kra19].
- INDEPENDENT REVIEW: MODEL SELF-REVIEW IS INSUFFICIENT. Agent reviews solve only about 40 percent of c-CRAB tasks [Zha26o], and SELF-VALIDATED ANALYSIS SUCCESS OVERSTATES MANUALLY VERIFIED SUCCESS [Bou26]. HUMAN REVIEW REMAINS ESSENTIAL for architecture, physical meaning, and unexplained numerical patches [Ngu26].

Claude Code, chat, Cowork and MCP can carry these controls as repository instructions, CI and pre-commit gates, typed tools and auditable logs; MCP/A2A STANDARDISES ACCESS, NOT SCIENTIFIC VALIDITY [Zha26k]. Citation verification and source-of-truth discipline remain comparatively unvalidated: closed-book systems' citation existence rates stayed below 0.475 [Zha26m].
